question: Find the badge names of users who have posted the most negative comments (score < 60) in 2013 and also own posts with above-average view counts.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_003
FROM badges AS b
JOIN users AS u ON b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT c.XCL_010
    FROM comments AS c
    WHERE c.XCL_010 IS NOT NULL
      AND c.XCL_007 < 60
      AND c.XCL_009 >= '2013-01-01'
      AND c.XCL_009 < '2014-01-01'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_010
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT MAX(cnt)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM comments AS c2
            WHERE c2.XCL_010 IS NOT NULL
              AND c2.XCL_007 < 60
              AND c2.XCL_009 >= '2013-01-01'
              AND c2.XCL_009 < '2014-01-01'
            GROUP BY c2.XCL_010
        )
    )
)
AND u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT p.XCL_033
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 IS NOT NULL
      AND p.XCL_030 > (SELECT AVG(XCL_030) FROM posts)
)

SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_003
FROM badges AS b
JOIN users AS u ON b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT c.XCL_010
    FROM comments AS c
    WHERE c.XCL_010 IS NOT NULL
      AND c.XCL_007 < 60
      AND c.XCL_009 >= '2013-01-01'
      AND c.XCL_009 < '2014-01-01'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_010
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT MAX(cnt)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM comments AS c2
            WHERE c2.XCL_010 IS NOT NULL
              AND c2.XCL_007 < 60
              AND c2.XCL_009 >= '2013-01-01'
              AND c2.XCL_009 < '2014-01-01'
            GROUP BY c2.XCL_010
        )
    )
)
AND u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT p.XCL_033
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 IS NOT NULL
      AND p.XCL_030 > (SELECT AVG(XCL_030) FROM posts)
)
